event.title: Coast Guard Searches for Missing Medical Evacuation Jet Off Nantucket
event.canonical_title: Coast Guard Searches for Missing Medical Evacuation Jet Off Nantucket
event.summary: The US Coast Guard is conducting a search for a Gulfstream medical evacuation jet that lost contact with flight controllers early Saturday morning. The aircraft, which was carrying six people, was en route from Bermuda to Boston when it went missing near Nantucket.

timeline.title: Debris Located from Missing Medical Evacuation Plane Off Massachusetts Coast
timeline.summary: Debris from a medical transport aircraft that went missing off the coast of Massachusetts has been found. The plane, which was conducting a medical evacuation from Bermuda with six people onboard, lost communication with flight controllers after a significant drop in altitude. The US Coast Guard is actively searching for the missing individuals.
key_facts: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers.
It was conducting a medical evacuation from Bermuda.
Debris was found off the coast of Nantucket Island.
